verses.1: They asked God, “At what time will Jehovah act? He creates thorns and brambles. He gives them to people who are like weeds in the field.”
verses.2: For the prophets spoke lies, and the magicians saw nothing but illusions. Their dreams were nothing but nonsense. Therefore, they went away like sheep without any hope.
verses.3: I struck the wicked with my sword, and I punished those who were evil. For Jehovah’s army had punished them, and they were destroyed in battle.
verses.4: From us came the defeat, from us came the destruction, from us came the war. From us all came destruction together.
verses.5: And they were like heroes who fought bravely in battles. They fought because Jehovah was with them, and they honored those who rode horses.
verses.6: And I will destroy the houses of Judah and the houses of Joseph. Their rulers will be destroyed, for I am Jehovah their God. I will save them, just as I never abandoned them before.
verses.7: And they shall be like kings over their own households. Their hearts shall rejoice like the joy of jubilees. In them, people will fear and rejoice. Their hearts shall be filled with joy in God.
verses.8: I will bless them and rejoice over them, for they are saved. They will increase in number, just as they did before.
verses.9: And they will be scattered among nations and in distant places. They will remember me, and their descendants will live again.
verses.10: And they will be brought back from the land of Egypt and from Assyria. We will bring them to the land of Gilad and Benjamin. But they will not be able to find any place for them there.
verses.11: And he crossed the sea, and he caused waves to rise in the sea. All the ships were destroyed by those waves. Ashur’s kingdom was overthrown, and the rulers of Egypt were defeated.
verses.12: And the elders in Jehovah’s name would walk, says Jehovah.
